mapper.select: SELECT wq.id, wq.user_id, wq.question_id, wq.attempt_id, wq.status, wq.wrong_count, wq.last_wrong_time, wq.next_review_time, wq.created_time FROM portal_wrong_question wq WHERE wq.user_id = #{userId} AND wq.status != 'mastered' ORDER BY wq.last_wrong_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'mastered' AND next_review_time IS NOT NULL AND next_review_time <= NOW()
SELECT * FROM portal_wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE portal_wrong_question SET status = 'mastered' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
